method: Static enumeration of every Cloud Scheduler job referenced from artifacts/syrabit-backend/. Wrapper at cloud_scheduler_client.py looks up jobs by full resource name; job names below are the project-level convention used by routes/admin_gcp_infra.py and the consumer routes cited.

jobs.name: seo-auto-publish
jobs.purpose: Daily/weekly auto-publish of SEO pages so the 991 syllabus topics steadily fill in without admin clicks (Task #458).

jobs.name: seo-publish-indexnow
jobs.purpose: Periodic IndexNow fanout sweep (catches anything the per-publish enqueue missed).

jobs.name: trustpilot-refresh
jobs.purpose: Refresh the Trustpilot aggregate cache (Task #728); heartbeat must reach App Insights or Task #751 silence alerter pages.

jobs.name: vertex-startup-probe
jobs.purpose: Live Vertex availability probe (still calls GCP via CF AI Gateway after the rebalance).

jobs.name: nightly-smoke
jobs.purpose: Run the full nightly-smoke.js suite from a managed cron (existing GitHub Actions kept as backup).

jobs.name: cf-bot-report
jobs.purpose: Daily Cloudflare bot-traffic report for admin dashboard.

jobs.name: db-cleanup
jobs.purpose: Atlas + Supabase prune (TTL on collections lacking TTL indexes).

jobs.name: bing-webmaster-refresh
jobs.purpose: Bing Webmaster Tools API refresh for crawl-budget metrics.

jobs.name: entity-seo-health
jobs.purpose: Daily Wikidata / Wikipedia / Crunchbase / Google KG entity-SEO probes (Task #940).

jobs.name: cliffhanger-engine-refresh
jobs.purpose: Refresh the cliffhanger ranking model used in chapter recommendations.

verification.owner_action: Re-run at the start of Phase 4 (AWS workers + Azure cron port) to confirm the live job set still matches this inventory. Any job present in the API response that is not listed here must be added before the cron is paused.
